Welcome To FLUX
Future Leaders of Unbound Xperiments
FLUX is a research and innovation club at MMMUT Gorakhpur. We build technology, not just study it.
What is FLUX?
FLUX is a student-driven research and innovation club at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, MMMUT Gorakhpur. We turn ideas into products, papers, and real-world impact through hands-on projects, hackathons, and industry collaboration.
Innovation Catalyst
Driving breakthroughs with cutting-edge research and creative problem-solving.
Advanced research methodologies
Creative problem-solving workshops
Innovation incubation programs
Interdisciplinary Platform
Fostering collaboration across multiple disciplines for comprehensive solutions.
Cross-departmental projects
Industry-academia partnerships
International research networks
Research Excellence
Maintaining the highest standards in research quality and academic integrity.
Peer-reviewed publications
International conference presentations
Acquisition of research grants
Show More Information
Leadership & Vision
FLUX is conceptualized and nurtured under the distinguished guidance of our esteemed Vice Chancellor.
VC
Prof. Anupama Kaushik Sharma
HON'BLE VICE CHANCELLOR, MMMUT GORAKHPUR
FLUX represents our unwavering commitment to fostering innovation and research excellence, creating leaders who will drive technological advancement and make meaningful contributions to society.
Our Core Values
These principles guide our actions and define our community.
Innovation
We constantly push boundaries, encouraging creative solutions and pioneering new ideas.
Collaboration
We believe in teamwork, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse minds connect and create.
Excellence
We are committed to the highest standards of quality and integrity in every project we undertake.
Impact
We focus on creating meaningful and positive impact on society through technology and leadership.
Our Impact Areas
FLUX acts as a catalyst for ideation, innovation, and interdisciplinary interaction.
Impact on Students
Empowering students through hands-on learning, real-world projects, and industry exposure.
Impact on Faculty
Creating avenues for mentorship, research collaboration, and professional growth.
Impact on Industry
Building a strong bridge between academia and industry for real-world innovation.
Impact on Research
Catalyzing ideation, innovation, and interdisciplinary research excellence.
Why FLUX Matters
FLUX is more than a club; it's a catalyst for growth, innovation, and career-defining opportunities.
1
Bridge the gap between classroom theory and industry practice through real projects and internships.
2
Give students research paths that lead to publications, patents, and stronger career outcomes.
3
Build a culture where innovation and entrepreneurship are normal, not exceptional.
4
Create lasting partnerships with industry and research institutions for sustained collaborative growth.
5
Develop technical depth and leadership skills that prepare students for real technology challenges.
6
Advance computer science and engineering through publishable research and working prototypes.
Our Mission
1
Build a research-first culture among students and faculty through funded projects and high-quality publications.
2
Organize hackathons, conferences, paper presentations, and tech conclaves that set new standards.
3
Create structured collaboration with industry experts, researchers, and startups for measurable impact.
4
Launch project incubation, interdisciplinary learning, and problem-solving programs that produce results.
5
Provide platforms for showcasing innovation through competitions, demos, and industry showcases.
6
Create in-house and global internship opportunities tied to real product and research milestones.
Ready to Join FLUX?
Stop consuming technology. Start building it. Join a community that ships.

Pioneering the next era of technology — where curious developers, bold innovators, and passionate tech enthusiasts unite to design, build, and shape the digital landscape of tomorrow.
